title: Carousel
purpose: Slider blocks: full-width slides (default), product image gallery, multi-card product slider, testimonial video + quote slider.
variantOption: classes (select): variant; legacy block classes (<legacy>, -wrapper, -container) are added by scripts/variants.js

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product image gallery: one large image at a time, prev/next chevrons, clickable thumbnail strip generated from the slides
visualCharacteristics.description: carousel-product (Biomek) is a multi-up slider of linked product cards with titles/descriptions; this is a single-image product gallery with thumbnail navigation: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: Product image gallery: 9 images, one visible at a time, prev/next chevrons and a thumbnail strip
contentPattern.structure: one row per image: (1) image; (2) optional caption

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for product image galleries beside the product intro. For multi-card sliders use carousel-product.
variants.usageDescription: Product image gallery: one large image at a time, prev/next chevrons, clickable thumbnail strip generated from the slides.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Multi-card slider of white bordered product cards with prev/next arrows (5/3/2/1 visible); arrows hide when all cards fit
visualCharacteristics.description: Content is ~100% the cards-product model (linked contained image + linked title + description/optional list), but it is a slider with prev/next arrows showing 5 of 6 left-aligned cards, so it is a carousel, not the 3-col wrapping grid. Parser logic for the cells can be shared with cards-product. | Identical source component and card anatomy (related-part__img-link, related-part__title, related-part__desc). Only 4 slides here, all visible, so arrows do not show; the block must hide/disable arrows when slides <= visible count.

contentPattern.summary: Slick carousel with prev/next arrows (5 visible of 6): white bordered product cards: linked image, bold linked h3 title, linked description (one card adds a paragraph + 8-item bullet list) | Slick slider of 4 white bordered product cards: linked image, bold linked title, linked description (+ disclaimer line)
contentPattern.structure: one row per card, same cells as cards-product: (1) image (optionally linked); (2) linked title heading + description / list

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for related / used-together product sliders. For a static grid use cards-product; for one-image galleries use carousel-gallery.
variants.usageDescription: Multi-card slider of white bordered product cards with prev/next arrows (5/3/2/1 visible); arrows hide when all cards fit.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Wistia testimonial video (5/12) beside a quote slider (7/12): red quote glyph, quote text, centred italic attribution, prev/next chevrons and dots
visualCharacteristics.description: carousel-product/-gallery are image/card sliders; this is a text-quote slider with dots paired with a fixed video pane. embed-wistia alone covers only the video.

contentPattern.summary: Wistia testimonial video (Evotec, 4:47) on the left (5/12) beside a 2-quote slider (red quote glyph, bold phrase, centered italic attribution, prev/next chevrons, dots) on the right (7/12)
contentPattern.structure: row 1 (block fields video_*): optional poster image + Wistia URL or id; then one row per quote (item `text`): quote paragraph(s) + italic attribution paragraph

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for customer quotes next to a testimonial video. For a video alone use embed-wistia; for image/card sliders use carousel-product or carousel-gallery.
variants.usageDescription: Wistia testimonial video (5/12) beside a quote slider (7/12): red quote glyph, quote text, centred italic attribution, prev/next chevrons and dots.
